verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sentry serves an llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and it describes Sentry as giving context to 'developers and their agents'. The Python docs also include an agent-oriented setup path that works with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md variant probe returned 404), documentation of llms.txt scope or contents beyond the header, independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Sentry is an application monitoring platform that helps developers and their agents have the context needed
Your agent will set up Sentry in your Python app automatically. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and more.
